about: Answer key for scanning fixtures/sample-repo against fixtures/sample-prds. Entries are keyed by where the requirement sits in the PRD (prd.file + prd.line), because not every requirement has a tag. 'parser' records whether today's PRD parser extracts it; src/cli/fixtures.test.ts checks that. Never copy anything from this file into sample-repo: the scan engine reads that folder.

findings.why: addItem finds the existing line and increases its quantity.
The code is looked up exactly as typed (only trimmed), so 'save10' is rejected.
render() shows the 'Your cart is empty' paragraph whenever the cart has no lines.
Free shipping starts above $50.00, so a subtotal of exactly $50.00 is charged $5.00: the customer pays money the spec says they should not.
The shop has no accounts or order pages at all. A missing feature is not a mismatch: reporting it as one is a false positive.
Any non-empty email enables 'Place order'; the address is never checked for a valid format.
